title: Three tiers, never conflated
subtitle: Passing one never implies another.
intent: three columns of equal weight; the third must not look optional

items.label: Deterministic
items: the stream, the audio, the captions

items.label: Frame evidence
items: does the picture match the voice
skipped means the tool was absent

items.label: Human review
items: stays pending until they say so
the only tier that can say published

notes: `skipped` maps only to "the tool was unavailable". A runtime failure is `failed`, and normalising the second into the first is how a broken tool reports a clean run.
